summary: Prestwick radar operating at a reduced flow rate due to a single controller, so aircraft using Prestwick as an alternate may face delays; inbound aircraft should monitor 121.5 megahertz.
text:
PRESTWICK RADAR OPR A REDUCED FLOW RATE DUE ATC SINGLE CONTROLLER.
ACFT WISHING TO USE PRESTWICK AS AN ALTN MAY EXPERIENCE DELAYS. ALL 
ACFT INBD TO PRESTWICK ARE TO MONITOR 121.5MHZ
